_doc: THE CRON ROSTER -- the ONE declaration of which packaged timers an installer arms.
Council #12 (2026-09-18): install.sh's CRON_DEFS armed 6, install/install_crons.sh armed 4,
the package ships 17 timers, and sleep-loop -- the only organ that writes consolidation_sources --
was in neither table. A stranger who installed with crons got a brain that never consolidated.
Every packaged cron/wizard-library-*.timer MUST appear here with arm = armed-by-default or
ships-as-template, explicitly and with a reason. Both installers read this file through
install/cron_roster.py; neither carries a table of its own. voidloom/tests/test_cron_roster.py
binds this file to cron/*.timer and cron/*.service in both directions.
exec is relative to the brain directory and MUST equal the packaged service's ExecStart after
%h/.claude/memory/ -> '', the brain DB -> {DB}, the sidecar sleep config -> {CFG},
%h/.claude/memory/<x> -> {BRAIN}/<x>. systemd is the packaged OnCalendar BYTE FOR BYTE: the package
ships no time zone, so every timer fires in the host's local time (R3). timeout is the packaged
TimeoutStartSec, or null when the packaged unit carries none (a oneshot then has no start
timeout, exactly as packaged). Placeholders are substituted by the installer, never here.
The ONE template (install/install_crons.sh install_linux) renders the majority shape: After=
network.target, Type=oneshot, Environment=PYTHON_KEYRING_BACKEND, EnvironmentFile=-<env file>,
ExecStart, WorkingDirectory, journal stdout/stderr, TimeoutStartSec; the timer: OnCalendar,
Persistent=true, WantedBy=timers.target. What a packaged unit carries BEYOND that shape is
declared per unit here, so the rendered body equals the packaged body (round-1 iteration-2
reflection, item 2 -- the template used to render After=network-online.target, matched by 0 of
17 packaged units, and lost organ-run-log's Nice=/Environment=PATH=/Documentation=):
service_extra: Key=Value lines added to the service (routed to [Unit]/[Service]/[Install] by
key; an After= here replaces the template's After=);
timer_extra:   Key=Value lines added to the timer (same routing; extra OnCalendar= lines allowed);
service_omit:  template lines the packaged unit does NOT carry, matched by prefix.
{HOME_LOCAL_BIN} -> $HOME/.local/bin. voidloom/tests/test_cron_roster.py renders every unit through
install_crons.sh --dry-run and proves the directive set equals the packaged unit's, all 17.
Interpreter: the installers run these units with the Tier-1 venv python when it exists
(organs that need sqlite_vec or torch), else the system python3.
thinks (model-choice unit, Round 1): true when the unit's PACKAGED invocation reaches organs/thinker.py on a
normal run -- it asks the owner's recorded overnight thinker (<brain>/THINKER_RECORD), or takes its simple
path when the owner answered e) not now. `cron_roster.py thinks` lists them: the units an installer may not arm
until the thinker question has an answer. sleep-loop is false because its packaged config (cron/
sleep-loop-config.json) is consolidation_mode heuristic; an owner config naming llm makes it think too.
The units' environment stays minimal: no thinker credential belongs in the env file -- the thinker reads
~/.voidloom/thinker/ and hands each backend only its own credential.
claude_credential (Round 2 wave 1, M13 with the owner's condition): how the unit's packaged invocation gets a
Claude credential -- thinker (through organs/thinker.py, which reads ~/.voidloom/thinker/claude.env before any
legacy home), env-file (it reads CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or an API key from its OWN environment, or launches
claude itself), none. DERIVED from the code (`cron_roster.py claude-callers --derive`: the entry points' import
closure over organs/, a static over-approximation) and pinned to it by voidloom/tests/test_cron_roster.py. `voidloom
thinker status`, the installer's DONE and the doctor say the owner's env-file token line can go ONLY when no armed
unit is env-file; otherwise they say it is STILL NEEDED and name the units.

sleep-loop.why: the only organ that writes consolidation_sources; without it a brain never consolidates (the 93-day defect, #20151: first run 9 clusters, second run idempotent)
sleep-loop.desc: Sleep Loop — nightly memory consolidation cycle

dreaming.why: nightly phase sequencer; LLM-billed only when a token exists, otherwise heuristic; After= also names the daytime unit so a same-second Persistent catch-up waits for the shared dream lock instead of losing the night (#20269)

anti-recency.why: weekly, local, no LLM; keeps foundation memories reachable

whisper-digest.why: weekly digest of the whisper network; LLM mode degrades to heuristic without a token

skill-graduation.why: weekly, local, no LLM; promotes provisional skills

gap-mapping.why: weekly inventory, local, no LLM (the research half is a template, see gap-research)

self-eval.why: monthly; LLM-billed only with a token

organ-run-log.why: the SENSOR for this roster (#17678, the pairing rule): hourly, local, no LLM; it records every armed unit's runs so silence is a row, not a guess
organ-run-log.desc: Organ run ledger — observes the armed units

gap-research.why: calls `claude -p` on every fire and bills the operator's token; arm it deliberately once the token exists (WIZARD_CRON_ONLY=gap-research with install_crons.sh)
gap-research.desc: Gap Research — dispatch auto-research for top knowledge gaps

cognitive-map.why: renders an HTML constellation nobody opens by default; opt in when you read it
cognitive-map.desc: Cognitive Map — weekly memory-constellation HTML regen

pre-cognitive.why: loads the embedding model every 30 minutes, 08:00-21:45 -- 28 model loads a day; on a CPU host that is the whole afternoon. Opt in on a GPU host that wants the pre-warmed banner
pre-cognitive.desc: Pre-Cognitive Recall — refresh anticipation cache + banner

affect-probe.why: L5-M2 Affect Lighthouse TRIAL instrument, not a product organ; its verdicts are still being calibrated (#20006)
affect-probe.desc: Affect Probe — daily forward-only sycophancy smoke scan

arcane-manifest.why: quarterly council-authored prose with haiku members and an opus synthesis: LLM-billed, and it shells out to `claude -p`
arcane-manifest.desc: Arcane Manifest — quarterly council co-authored prose narrative

belief-scan.why: proposes contradiction edges into the approvals queue; arm it once there is a reader of that queue on this machine
belief-scan.desc: Belief engine — drain the scan queue and propose contradiction edges

counterfactual-revisit.why: quarterly LLM-billed decision review; four OnCalendar lines emulate a quarter
counterfactual-revisit.desc: Counterfactual Revisit — quarterly decision path review

dream-daytime.why: the 14:00 GPU-burst window is one machine's daily rhythm (the author is not gaming then); a stranger's afternoon is not scheduled by this package

organ-yield.why: a sentinel over the ledger that organ-run-log writes; arm it after a week of ledger rows exist to judge, or it reports every organ as yielding nothing
organ-yield.desc: Organ yield sentinel — reports organs that run but produce nothing

embed-backfill.why: round 1 (L5): the safety net for organ write paths that stored a memory without a vector (359 found by the 2026-10-14 health check); idempotent, refuses rather than guessing a tier, exit 3 (keyword-only Tier 0) admitted. Armed by the owner's ruling (2026-10-15): it makes no LLM call and loads the embedder once a day, so a missed vector is repaired by morning instead of waiting for someone to notice
embed-backfill.desc: Embedding backfill — a vector for every live memory stored without one
